Soul Absorption

A Guardian's (Charmed) signature move, is to siphon out Souls from their bodily vessels after getting physically murdered.

Power/Ability to:

Absorb souls.
"So I've taken a few hundred souls - big deal!"
― Snatcher (A Hat in Time)
"But despite your incarnation, too much of your essence is still bound up in your city and its people. It's unfortunate, but I have no other way to separate you. But it's all right. This was never about them. I've taken apart hundreds of mortal Souls. They have nothing left to teach me."
― The Collector (Aurora (2019))

The power to devour subjects as souls. Sub-power of Soul Manipulation. Variation of Absorption.

Also Called[]

  • Dementor's Kiss (Harry Potter)
  • Diablerie (Vampire: The Masquerade)
  • Essence/Spirit Absorption
  • Soul/Spirit/Essence Collecting/Collection/Consuming/Consumption/Devouring/Draining/Harvesting/Robbery/Stealing/Sucking/Theft
  • Soul Steal (Castlevania series)

Capabilities[]

The user can absorb/devour individuals as souls, while removing them from the source, into their body and use it in various ways, gaining some form of advantage, either by enhancing themselves, gaining the drained power, using it as a power source, etc., either temporarily or permanently.

Common advantages include adding the target's skills and abilities to users or using the absorbed souls to augment the user's own powers.

Applications[]

  • Absorbing Regeneration
  • Apparition Materialization
  • Assimilation Shield
  • Death Inducement
  • Energy Empowerment
  • Enhanced Condition/Supernatural Condition
  • Knowledge Absorption
    • Memory Absorption
  • Mind Absorption
  • Life-Force Absorption
  • Psychometry
  • Soul Carrier
  • Soul Empowerment
  • Soul Energy Absorption
  • Soul Metabolization
  • Soul Removal
  • Superpower Absorption since superpowers are usually related to their souls
  • Reincarnation Denial
  • Obtain access to items hidden in souls, like Soul-Bound Weapon.

Variations[]

  • Blood-Fueled Soul Absorption
  • Soul Assimilation
  • Sleeping Soul Absorption

Associations[]

  • Absorption
  • Afterlife Prevention
  • Death Inducement
  • Death Empowerment
  • Life Reduction
  • Mind Absorption
  • Reincarnation Denial
  • Shapeshifting to the absorbed soul's former shape.
  • Soul Channeling
  • Soul Destruction
  • Soul Manipulation
  • Soul Mutilation

Limitations[]

  • Humongous souls, as well as beings as either supernatural souls, or enhanced souls, may be incredibly difficult if not impossible to devour, being resistant against the user's power.
  • May be limited to how much one can absorb.
  • May have a limit for how many souls one can contain within.
  • May have limited range, including touch only.
  • May unintentionally gain Divided Mind due to souls having sentient minds to begin with.
  • May have to continually absorb souls to survive.
  • Soulless entities are immune.
  • The absorbed may influence the user's decisions making if they are benevolent or malevolent entities and they might be willing to help the user in various situations if they are willing to help the user to begin with.
  • The absorbed soul may have access to the users body and tampering with the user's emotions and they will know everything there is know about the user as well as their strength and weaknesses.
  • May only be able to absorb certain kinds of souls, such as supernatural beings.
  • Absorbing the captured into the user's self may pose some inconsistencies, as that would then mean that at least two souls must now inhabit the same physical body.
  • While the user could also absorb elemental-based spirits without any difficulty, most elements can be extremely dangerous for the user to absorb, resulting in nasty outcomes. For example, if the user happens to absorb a soul that is of poisonous origin, the user could suffer and then physically die.
  • Users of Soul Restoration, Absolute Restoration/Flawless Restoration can restore souls, especially fitting them back into their bodily vessels in order to live again.
  • Users of either Eternal Soul, Absorption Immunity and Soul Anchoring are immune.
    • Offensive Immunity
  • Absorption Negation
